scripts.prod:up: BOT_REVISION=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) docker compose --env-file .env.production -f infra/docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --build
scripts.prod:down: BOT_REVISION=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) docker compose --env-file .env.production -f infra/docker-compose.prod.yml down
scripts.prod:logs: BOT_REVISION=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) docker compose --env-file .env.production -f infra/docker-compose.prod.yml logs -f bot
scripts.gh:setup: bun run gh:setup-repo && bun run gh:setup-project
